# <status-message>

Inline notification banners for important messages. Use for success confirmations, warnings, errors, and informational notices.

- CSS-only custom element. Works without JavaScript.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/custom-elements/status-message/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<status-message data-variant="success">
  <section data-content>
    <strong data-title>Success</strong>
    <p data-description>Your changes have been saved.</p>
  </section>
</status-message>
```
